data.body:
## External documentation and shipped help shard report

The survey covered README.md, root community policies, client guides, CLI help, generated CLI and MCP references, MCP descriptions, package metadata, templates, demonstrations, example skills, integration setup, operator runbooks, and client-facing strings. No project file changed.

### Confirmed P0 corrections

- Operation certificates. README.md, docs/manifest-signing.md, docs/event-schema.md, docs/reuse-surface.md, docs/repo-snapshot-gates.md, docs/plan-review-gate.md, docs/sample-ticket-log.jsonl, src/rebar/_cli/help/sign.txt, and generated CLI text describe HMAC as the current gate mechanism. src/rebar/schemas/sign_result.schema.json, src/rebar/signing.py, tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_signature.py, docs/migrations/hmac-opcert-removal.md, ADR 0044, ADR 0049, educatory-astrakhan-wallaroo, and decorative-childly-auk establish DSSE envelopes signed through SSHSIG for plan-review and completion-verifier certificates. Generic HMAC utilities and legacy reads remain for other consumers. Cookie and webhook HMAC material remains valid. docs/llm-framework.md should not appear in the confirmed defect list.
- Import behavior. src/rebar/_cli/help/import.txt, docs/import-export.md, and generated CLI text describe duplicate creation or future batching. src/rebar/_io/import_ndjson.py, its tests, ADR 0039, and cold-stall-chalk establish source_id-based idempotency, chunk commits, push after import work, and crash resumption.
- Jira project configuration. docs/config.md, docs/jira-sync-setup.md, bridge-probe help, and generated CLI text describe a DIG fallback or optional JIRA_PROJECT. src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/access_check.py, runtime.py, and src/rebar/_bridge_runner.py require a project for access, inbound scope, and writes. Merge this correction into the Jira setup work. Require rebar bridge projects set, preflight, first synchronization, observation, recovery, and rollback. ADR 0070 and vein-acid-navy provide history.
- Identity setup. docs/identity-setup.md rejects GITHUB_ENV although maintained workflows use it for later steps. Correct that claim, use verify-identity as the canonical command, identify verify-authorship as a compatibility alias, and name session_log, code_review, and identity as exact exempt types. The guide already mentions verification and conceptual exemptions. Remove the earlier omission claim. ADR 0045 supplies decision context.
- Ticket model and close behavior. README.md, docs/README.md, docs/user-guide.md, AGENTS.md, templates/rebar-usage.md, templates/AGENTS.md, and docs/assets/rebar-demo.svg contain six-relation, bare-assignee, deprecated identifier, unlink, or close-scope drift. src/rebar/graph/_links.py defines seven relations including caused_by. src/rebar/_cli/help/unlink.txt accepts an optional relation. docs/config.md establishes configured default assignment and Jira-resolvable overrides. src/rebar/_commands/close_precheck.py exempts only session_log, code_review, and identity before completion checks for ordinary work tickets.
- CLI option coverage. src/rebar/_cli/_parsers/core/writes.py accepts detected_by. src/rebar/_cli/_parsers/core/lifecycle.py accepts caused_by and ref. src/rebar/_cli/help/create.txt and transition.txt omit part of that syntax. Correct present omissions separately from top-level command discovery. Leave registry discovery implementation to grapy-cynical-copepod, premium-drizzly-weaverbird, loony-fabric-bunny, and pettish-snippy-rasbora, then verify generated output.
- Adoption assets. templates/AGENTS.md, templates/rebar-usage.md, docs/assets/rebar-demo.svg, examples/agent-skills/rebar-implement/SKILL.md, and examples/agent-skills/rebar-brainstorm/SKILL.md teach non-atomic claim substitutes, bare identities, incomplete relations, deprecated identifiers, or unsigned fast failures as successful reviews. Split client templates, demonstration assets, and agent-skill examples. Establish ownership before editing the SVG because no generator was identified.
- MCP authentication and Gerrit state. src/rebar/_mcp_auth.py says only the static verifier ships although its factory and tests cover five strategies. infra/terraform/modules/sso-gate/README.md points to missing infra/shared/auth/RUNBOOK.md instead of infra/runbooks/sso-auth-host.md. infra/runbooks/two-vote-gate-rollback.md calls the Verified submit rule inactive although infra/gerrit/project.config makes it active. Split MCP authentication from Gerrit operations.

### Confirmed P1 corrections

- README.md contains two installation sections and combines client onboarding with dependency design, gate internals, source paths, contributor process, and test tiers. Keep installation, first use, concepts, interfaces, and client navigation. Preserve the quickstart contract delivered by tsunamic-wax-hog.
- docs/user-guide.md omits caused_by and includes router mechanics, blame selection, and credential incident narration. Organize it by client goals and remove implementation history.
- docs/config-reference.md is generated by scripts/gen_config_reference.py. Make it the external settings contract. Keep extension invariants in a separate internal document. Correct docs/config.md references to ADR 0086 for cross-ticket overlap and ADR 0087 for transport retry.
- src/rebar/_guides/writing-a-passing-plan.md should remain task focused. Reviewer design belongs in docs/plan-review-gate.md and docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md. Preserve dependency-order review and the status-check workflow. sullen-famished-incatern supplies retry history.
- docs/chatgpt-agent-guide.md gives inconsistent fsck and validate guidance. Present one checkout detection, sanctioned import, validation, recovery, and escalation sequence.
- scripts/gen_mcp_reference.py truncates registrar descriptions at the first physical line. scripts/check_server_manifest.py compares environment names but not descriptions. Split multiline summary generation from manifest description validation. Registrar text and manifest metadata remain canonical. docs/mcp-reference.md is generated output.
- SUPPORT.md relies on GitHub Issues while infra/runbooks/github-mirror-lock.md says to disable Issues and Actions. The Verified gate needs Actions. CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md and SUPPORT.md already provide a Nava PBC backstop. Clarify the shared address and unnamed backstop rather than claiming no independent route. Include issue forms and contact links.
- pyproject.toml packages only LICENSE while an alias wordlist cites docs/licenses/adjective-adjective-animal-LICENSE.txt. Package the required license text. Research the legacy ticket wordlist source and tests/external/live_jira_dc/Dockerfile upstream revision and license before prescribing provenance metadata. NOTICE treatment remains a packaging choice. examples/agent-skills/rebar-brainstorm/SKILL.md lacks the name field required by examples/agent-skills/README.md.

### Audience and source rules

External actions should describe user-visible setup, verification, timing, partial results, reruns, failure, recovery, and rollback. Router, registrar, mapper, reducer, writer, blame-selection, and criterion-routing terms belong only in evidence or internal documentation.

Generated configuration, CLI, MCP, ADR index, synchronized template, schema, and demonstration artifacts must change through maintained sources. If no source exists, remediation must establish ownership first.

Historical tickets and commits remain unchanged. Corrections use append-only records or linked notices. Licenses, quotations, captures, frozen model output, serialized fixtures, wording-under-test material, syntax, identifiers, and generated output remain protected. Scan counts are triage signals rather than defect totals.

### Adjudication and gaps

No confirmed correction was rejected. C14 merges into C15. C29, C30, and C32 merge into surface-specific comment and history tasks. C33 splits into MCP authentication, S3 operations, and Gerrit operations. No specific S3 accuracy defect was established, so S3 remains a prose and audience review unless further evidence appears. C34 splits package license provenance, Jira Data Center fixture provenance, and example metadata.

Coverage additions should include .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE files, .github/pull_request_template.md, .github/copilot-instructions.md, package descriptions and project URLs, server manifest descriptions, Makefile help, Dockerfile comments, workflow annotations, spoken demonstration narration, and YAML, TOML, HCL, and shell help text.

### Tracker note

Two earlier comments were added to homemade-coltish-donkey after resumed context identified this agent as the root agent. They contain the 34-item draft and combined filter disposition. No other tracker state changed.
